_comment: Reviews from anywhere that isn't Gumroad, added by hand. The daily sync rewrites gumroad.json wholesale, so nothing here can live in that file. Same shape as a Gumroad entry: 'rating' is optional, 'url' is where the review is published, and there are no names on purpose.

reviews.message: Amazed by the work. Very Smart and very low cpu usage.

This is the best De-Esser I have ever used... A lot of very smart technology wrapped up in a tiny install and a zero latency plugin... It's a real gem and the only de-esser that I use now... We are spoilt for choice in the digital world, but it's plugins like this that stand out from the crowd... I am very grateful to the folks who coded this.... IA De-Esser is a Class A plugin that should be in the top shelf of everyone's digital toolbox.. It's a no brainer... Thank you...
